meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 按你给定的时间范围查询飞书会议记录，取回每场会议的纪要文档与逐字稿链接，整理成结构化报告；单日给「今日会议概览」，多日给周报，用户要求时可生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报，或回顾某段时间开了哪些会时接管。默认时间范围为过去 7 天，仅支持 user 身份，需先授权 vc。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 默认按本周一至今查询

say.text: 把这些会议纪要汇总生成一篇云文档
say.note: 调用 docs +create 生成文档

howto.what_en: Queries Lark meetings in the time range you give, pulls each meeting's notes and verbatim transcript links, and turns them into a structured report: a daily overview or a weekly summary, optionally written to a Lark doc.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to organize meeting notes, build a weekly meeting report, or review which meetings happened in a period. Defaults to the past 7 days; user identity only, vc auth required.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
say_en.note: Queries from Monday to now by default

say_en.text: Show me which meetings happened today
Turn these meeting notes into a Lark doc
